Transport Documents

รายงานการรับมอบสินค้า

A report detailing the quantity and condition of goods as actually discharged at the port of destination, highlighting discrepancies with the bill of lading or manifest.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A report detailing the quantity and condition of goods as actually discharged at the port of destination, highlighting discrepancies with the bill of lading or manifest.

Operational example

The outturn report is used to settle claims for short landed or damaged cargo when discharge results differ from shipping documents.
